A lone railroad isn't worth a real bid. One dollar.

your_private_thoughts_last_10.thought: On Water Works, cash $546. Non-LB-deed liq $996 (States $70+Ventnor $130+10 houses $250). Next roll: 9=Park 3h $1100 (4/36, monopoly death, survive only by mortgaging LB, ~$56 left); 11=Boardwalk $1400 (2/36, bankrupt, full liq $1156); Chance 8 mostly safe except Advance to Boardwalk. p1 and p2 are on Pacific and cannot reach LB (15+). p2 ($162) cannot buy a $200 dark-blue house before I roll. Building VT/CT costs $50 each, earns nothing before that roll, and drops net liq $25/house. Do not sell houses, mortgage, or unmortgage. Do not trade: p2 will not pay ≥$104 for dead mortgaged greens while holding the kill shot; States completes their pink and even all their cash doesn't clear $1100 after losing the $70 mortgage value. Never give States, Ventnor, or LB. Rebuild 4ths only after clearing Park/Boardwalk with the monopoly intact.

Only p2 left. Short Line mortgage value is $100. Bid $1 so I can raise later up to $99 (net +$1 if I mortgage before rolling) or make them pay ~$100 instead of gifting it at $0. Do not go to $100+. Their Baltic/Kentucky/Illinois mortgages mean I cannot drain them below a $200 Park house; if they build Park to 4h ($1300) my full liq $1156 still dies on 9 and 11. If they don't build, Park 3h $1100 is survivable only with max liquidity — mortgage Short Line before the roll if I win it under $100. Never give them States. Drop if they bid >= $100.

Win Short Line under $100 and mortgage it before the roll: mortgage value $100, so any win ≤$99 is net cash and widens the Park 3h $1100 cushion. p2 can still raise a $200 dark-blue house via Kentucky/Illinois mortgages, so draining them here does not stop the kill house — the +liquidity is the prize. Keep raising to $99; drop at $100+.

Only p2 left. Short Line mortgages for $100, so any win ≤$99 is net cash if I mortgage before I roll from Water Works. Current non-LB liq $996; +net still won't fully clear Park 3h $1100 or a 4h $1300, but it reduces how much LB I must strip on a 9. p2 ($225 + Baltic/KY/IL mortgages) can still buy the dark-blue house no matter what they pay here — don't chase them. Keep raising $1 at a time to $99; drop at $100+.
